gloss: fourteen days; the fourteenth (of the month)

definitions.explanation: A duration of fourteen days. Often written {十四日間|じゅうよっかかん} when the length of time needs to be explicit.

definitions.gloss: the fourteenth day of the month

examples.japanese: {十四日|じゅうよっか}かかった。
{申請|しんせい}から{十四日|じゅうよっか}{以内|いない}に{返事|へんじ}が{来|き}ます。
examples.english: A reply comes within fourteen days of the application.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}の{出張|しゅっちょう}は{十四日間|じゅうよっかかん}の{予定|よてい}だったが、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{延|の}びた。
examples.english: The overseas business trip was scheduled for fourteen days, but it was extended by a week.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{十四日|じゅうよっか}は{日曜日|にちようび}だ。
examples.english: The fourteenth of this month is a Sunday.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}は{三月|さんがつ}{十四日|じゅうよっか}に{行|おこな}われます。
examples.english: The interview will be held on March 14th.

examples.japanese: {二月|にがつ}{十四日|じゅうよっか}のバレンタインデーには、{毎年|まいとし}{職場|しょくば}でチョコレートを{配|くば}っている。
examples.english: On Valentine's Day, February 14th, I hand out chocolates at work every year.

notes:
One of the few dates above the tenth that keeps a native reading: {四日|よっか} survives inside it, so it is じゅうよっか, never じゅうよんにち. The same happens with {二十四日|にじゅうよっか}.

USAGE:
- Duration: {十四日|じゅうよっか}かかる (takes fourteen days)
- Date: {十四日|じゅうよっか}に{会|あ}う (meet on the 14th)
- {十四日間|じゅうよっかかん}: an explicit fourteen-day period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {四日|よっか}: four days; the 4th — the reading this word inherits
- {二十四日|にじゅうよっか}: twenty-four days; the 24th — the other irregular よっか date
- {二週間|にしゅうかん}: two weeks — more natural than {十四日|じゅうよっか} for a fortnight in casual speech
